headline: Six Fronts Surge as War Enters Day 496
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the most volatile corridors have reshuffled. Nevish Line still leads with fifty ownership changes in the past day; the latest hour shows Colonial losses at 67 per hour and Warden losses at 80, both accelerating, though the two‑hour trend has begun to cool. Callahans Passage remains a meat‑grinder with twenty‑one flips; the newest hour records 900 Colonial and 681 Warden casualties, both accelerating, while enlistments dip. Weathered Expanse has risen to thirty‑nine exchanges; a sudden surge to 344 Colonial and 559 Warden casualties in the last hour contrasts with a two‑hour cooling trend. Palantine Berm’s flips hold at thirty‑five; the latest hour shows steady casualties but enlistments rising sharply. Stlican Shelf adds sixteen flips with a fresh hour of 365 Colonial and 336 Warden casualties accelerating, while the two‑hour window shows mixed signals. Stonecradle reports ten flips, modest casualties now accelerating at 12 and 15 per hour but cooling over two hours. All other regions remain largely static, held wholly by one side with only low‑level attrition.
